description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Neriv, adding {C}{C}.
When Neriv dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Neriv from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Neriv enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
